title: Promise and Summer
author: Oscar Winterbourne
blurb: Wendell Dunmore, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
